# flag-icons 7.2.3

Unmodified 4:3 SVG country flags (`4x3/<iso-alpha-2>.svg`) from
https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons, version 7.2.3. MIT, see `LICENSE`.
Same snapshot as the D4/CIRCL mmdb-server web interface.

Used by the IP detail Informations tab (country row and map popup) through
`app/static/js/ip_map.js`. Only two-letter codes are ever put in the URL;
a missing flag is hidden.
